newsitem.title: USA: NJ Transit okays $590 mln capital budget - paper.
newsitem.headline: NJ Transit okays $590 mln capital budget - paper.

text.p: NJ Transit on Tuesday approved a $590 million capital budget, the Bergen Record reported Wednesay.
The plan includes $30 million of funding for emergency braking systems that might prevent future collisions like one that claimed three lives last year, the paper said.
The budget also relies on federal funding from the $151 billion Intermodal Surface Transportation Efficiency Act that could be cut this year.
Agency officials said if that funding source were reduced they would address the problem at that time.
The spending plan also includes money for a Secaucus transfer station and the Hudson-Bergen Light Rail Transit System.
